description: Create an outgoing expense only. For money received (Venmo/Cash App/PayPal/Zelle) use log_transaction with direction=from and type=income. Lending a contact cash: category "IOU lend" + person_id (one call creates the IOU they owe and shows the money out once). ($0.10; API key required)

cash_moved.description: With category "IOU lend": true (default) = cash changed hands as a loan (shows in Finance); false = an owed share, e.g. of a dinner logged as its own expense (IOU only). Ignored for iou_type invoice.

category.description: "IOU repayment" = paying a contact back; "IOU lend" = lending a contact cash (both need person_id).

client_label.description: Optional free-text client label for an invoice IOU.

external_id.description: The provider's id for this payment; dedupes imports. Without a request_id it is required.

iou_type.description: loan (default) or invoice. Invoice = unpaid receivable: no Finance outflow on create; payment is income "Invoice payment". Use for invoice/receivable phrasings; "I lent…" → loan.

notes.description: Free text about the payment. Alias: description.

person_id.description: The contact paid (needed for "IOU repayment" / "IOU lend").

person_name.description: The contact by name, when there is no person_id (IOU categories need one or the other).

project.description: Venture/project label → stored as project:{slug} tag (e.g. Max Soko poker venture)

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

source.description: Payment rail or app: venmo, zelle, cashapp, card, cash, … Alias: payment_method.

tags.description: Optional tags. Prefer project: / ext: / rail: grammar.
